title.en: Stay on one row while resolving which pump prints 900 m for infrastructure
title.zh: 选型时不要并格：哪一台泵为基建印了 900 米

description.en: Read it in the Xingtai table. Electric 80. Xingtai-based Hebei Pinjin Machinery prints high-rise and long-distance pumping, large commercial and infrastructure pours, and jobs needing the 60 m³/h catalogue output. Keep this cell as published. The table is 110 kW, 60 m³/h, 40 MPa, hopper 0.7 m³, 900 m horizontal / 300 m vertical, aggregate 24 mm (≤ 2 cm), 6600 × 1800 × 1800 mm and 6000 kg. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. The infrastructure page cites this horizontal cell as the longest in the catalogue.
description.zh: 按邢台表上的原文理解：电动80。邢台河北品锦机械印了高层与长距离泵送、大型商业与基建浇筑，以及需要目录 60 m³/h 的工程。表是 110 kW、60 m³/h、40 MPa、料斗 0.7 m³、水平 900 m / 垂直 300 m、骨料 24 mm（≤ 2 cm）、外形 6600 × 1800 × 1800 mm、6000 kg。基建页把这个水平格称为目录中最长的一格。

directAnswer.zh: 按邢台表上的原文理解：电动80。邢台河北品锦机械印了高层与长距离泵送、大型商业与基建浇筑，以及需要目录 60 m³/h 的工程。表是 110 kW、60 m³/h、40 MPa、料斗 0.7 m³、水平 900 m / 垂直 300 m、骨料 24 mm（≤ 2 cm）、外形 6600 × 1800 × 1800 mm、6000 kg。基建页把这个水平格称为目录中最长的一格。

body.en: The section shape comes from “Carbon Steel Pipes and Tubes” in “Process Pipes - Allowable Stress vs. Temperature”. The sentences are a restatement of the catalogue, not of that article. Read it in the Xingtai table. Electric 80 prints 900 m horizontal / 300 m vertical, 110 kW, 60 m³/h, 40 MPa and aggregate 24 mm (≤ 2 cm). The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. The table is 110 kW, 60 m³/h, 40 MPa, hopper 0.7 m³, 900 m horizontal / 300 m vertical, aggregate 24 mm (≤ 2 cm), 6600 × 1800 × 1800 mm and 6000 kg. Keep this cell as published. A 4 cm mix belongs on HBT8018 or HBT80-16, which print 4 cm and below and much shorter horizontal cells (150 m conveying, or 120 m). Taken from the printed row: Electric 80 is an electric trailer pump. Read it in the Xingtai table. The 900 m figure does not transfer. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. Use /contact, the on-site WhatsApp button, PinjinHebei@Outlook.com or 19912003025. Keep this cell as published. HBT80-16 prints 120 m horizontal even though the code string HBT80-1816-110 also appears there. Image from the source page: https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/temperature-allowable-stresses-pipes-d_1338.html
body.zh: 这一节的形状来自《Process Pipes - Allowable Stress vs. Temperature》的“钢管”。文字是目录的转述，不是那篇文章的原文。按邢台表上的原文理解：电动80印了水平 900 m / 垂直 300 m、110 kW、60 m³/h、40 MPa、骨料 24 mm（≤ 2 cm）。旁边那一台不在这句话里。电动80是电动拖泵。供不起这台电机的偏远基建工地去柴油目录：柴油120印的是 150 m / 500 m、100 m³/h，不是水平 900 m。LZ-80 印的是输送 120 m。900 m 这个数字不能搬走。这一格照已印出的读：不是。HBT80-16 印的是水平 120 m，尽管代号 HBT80-1816-110 也出现在那一页。图来自来源页面：https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/temperature-allowable-stresses-pipes-d_1338.html

heading.en: Low and Intermediate Alloy Steel Pipes and Tubes

body.en: “Process Pipes - Allowable Stress vs. Temperature” breaks its subject at “Low and Intermediate Alloy Steel Pipes and Tubes”. Here the same break only holds the cells this model already prints. Taken from the printed row: Electric 80. Read it in the Xingtai table. The infrastructure page cites this horizontal cell as the longest in the catalogue. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. A 6 cm mix belongs on LZ-80 or Diesel 120. Keep this cell as published. A remote infrastructure site without that supply is the diesel catalogue: Diesel 120 prints 150 m / 500 m at 100 m³/h, not 900 m horizontal. Taken from the printed row: Confirm aggregate is within 2 cm and that 110 kW is available, or say the site is off-grid. Do not attach a project name, a country job or a daily volume the catalogue leaves that cell blank for. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. It is the theoretical output cell, not a measured pour on a named job.
body.zh: 《Process Pipes - Allowable Stress vs. Temperature》在“低位钢管”处把题目拆开。这里这一段只放这台机器已经印出的格子。电动80。河北品锦机械（邢台）印了高层与长距离泵送、大型商业与基建浇筑，以及需要目录 60 m³/h 的工程。表是 110 kW、60 m³/h、40 MPa、料斗 0.7 m³、水平 900 m / 垂直 300 m、骨料 24 mm（≤ 2 cm）、外形 6600 × 1800 × 1800 mm、6000 kg。基建页把这个水平格称为目录中最长的一格。按邢台表上的原文理解：请确认骨料在 2 cm 以内且有 110 kW，或者说明工地没有电网。旁边那一台不在这句话里。它是理论输送量格，不是某个具名工程上测到的浇筑量。

body.en: Borrow “Seamless Austenitic Alloys Steel Pipes” from “Process Pipes - Allowable Stress vs. Temperature” as the skeleton, and fill it with the printed window for this page. Keep this cell as published. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints high-rise and long-distance pumping, large commercial and infrastructure pours, and jobs needing the 60 m³/h catalogue output. Taken from the printed row: The aggregate cell is 24 mm (≤ 2 cm). Read it in the Xingtai table. Do not keep 900 m after the stone leaves 2 cm. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. LZ-80 prints 120 m conveying. Keep this cell as published. Send Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai the mix, the largest stone or particle, the output you need, the horizontal and vertical pipe you measured, and whether the site has grid voltage or must use diesel. Taken from the printed row: No. Read it in the Xingtai table. Kawasaki 140 double pump, as printed on Electric 80. Headings already printed: 2 cm stone is part of the 900 m row 110 kW is a site condition
body.zh: 把《Process Pipes - Allowable Stress vs. Temperature》的“钢管”借来当骨架，里面填的是本页这一格已经印出的窗口。这一格照已印出的读：骨料格是 24 mm（≤ 2 cm）。4 cm 的料属于 HBT8018 或 HBT80-16，它们印 4 cm 及以下，水平短得多（输送 150 m，或水平 120 m）。6 cm 的料属于 LZ-80 或柴油120。石子离开 2 cm 之后，不要留着 900 m。目录里已经写着：请把配合比、最大石子或粒径、需要的输送量、量到的水平与垂直管路，以及现场是电网还是必须用柴油，发给邢台的河北品锦机械。途径是 /contact、站内 WhatsApp、PinjinHebei@Outlook.com 或 19912003025。不要附上目录里没有的项目名称、国家工程或日浇筑方量。按邢台表上的原文理解：电动80上印的是川崎 140 双泵。已印出的标题：2 cm 石子是 900 米这一行的一部分 110 kW 是现场条件

question.en: “Carbon Steel Pipes and Tubes” does not change the check: Is HBT80-16 also 900 m?
question.zh: “钢管”不改这一问：HBT80-16 也是 900 米吗？

answer.en: Read it in the Xingtai table. No. HBT80-16 prints 120 m horizontal even though the code string HBT80-1816-110 also appears there.
answer.zh: 按邢台表上的原文理解：不是。HBT80-16 印的是水平 120 m，尽管代号 HBT80-1816-110 也出现在那一页。

question.en: Is 60 m³/h the infrastructure promise, once the outline says “Low and Intermediate Alloy Steel Pipes and Tubes”?
question.zh: 大纲写着“低位钢管”时，60 m³/h 是基建承诺吗？

answer.en: Taken from the printed row: It is the theoretical output cell, not a measured pour on a named job.
answer.zh: 目录里已经写着：它是理论输送量格，不是某个具名工程上测到的浇筑量。

question.en: Under “Seamless Austenitic Alloys Steel Pipes”, what is the hydraulic pump cell?
question.zh: 在“钢管”这一节里，液压泵格是什么？

answer.en: Keep this cell as published. Kawasaki 140 double pump, as printed on Electric 80.
answer.zh: 这一格照已印出的读：电动80上印的是川崎 140 双泵。
